All three Reach actions use local retained Stream evidence, not another USGS
request. `mod_boundary_server` wires separate action helpers to the same map,
storage adapter, activity guard and save callback. Separate draft state prevents
an Add preview from authorizing a Split or Combine save.

## Shared source and publication paths

Parent Stream selection calls `store$stream_segments`, which checks the revision
and calls `fluvgeo::read_study_stream_segments`. The reader supplies retained
lines, buffer metadata, assignments and selection IDs. The Add helper exposes
this source to the Combine and Split helpers.

| Action | UI helper | Preview through adapter | Injected publication writer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Add new | `reach_selection_server` | `preview_reach` → `fluvgeo::preview_study_reach_corridor` | `fluvgeo::add_study_reach_corridor` |
| Combine existing | `reach_merge_server` | `preview_reach_merge` → `fluvgeo::preview_study_reach_merge` | `fluvgeo::merge_study_reaches` |
| Split existing | `reach_split_server` | `preview_reach_split` → `fluvgeo::preview_study_reach_split` | `fluvgeo::split_study_reach` |

Save routes pass through the adapter's local `revise` closure; the writer argument
is a function, not a string evaluated as code. Writers recompute from current
evidence rather than trusting a browser-submitted preview polygon. Successful
publication is reread and passed to `on_saved`, rebuilding the revision editor.

## Concrete trace: Split existing

1. `reach_split_server` registers `map_click` and `map_shape_click` observers.
2. An enabled observer validates longitude/latitude and constructs a WGS84 point.
3. Local `make_preview` calls `store$preview_reach_split` under progress feedback.
4. The adapter checks staleness, then calls `fluvgeo::preview_study_reach_split`.
5. The backend snaps in the inherited metric CRS, partitions the supported line,
   constructs inherited buffers, and returns lengths, areas and identity choice.
6. Save calls `store$split_reach`; its `revise(..., writer=fluvgeo::split_study_reach)`
   call publishes the new revision and piece evidence. `on_saved` updates the UI.

The click itself previews; it never saves. Changing the retained side invalidates
the preview. The downstream portion keeps the old identity by default, but the
analyst may choose upstream. The other portion requires a new name and ID.

## Different actions have different child-record rules

| Action | Identity/assignment rule | Important limit |
|---|---|---|
| Add | New Reach; selected unassigned pieces belong to it | Duplicate assignment is refused |
| Combine | Analyst chooses one surviving Reach; retired parents' Survey Events are reassigned | Linked network/terrain records require reconciliation and block |
| Split | Retain one Reach identity and create another | Target Survey Events and linked network/terrain records block; no guessed reassignment |

The merge guard is context-wide: any non-null `network` or `folder_manifest`
blocks merging, not just a reference proven to belong to a selected Reach.
Survey Events alone do not block a merge. In sibling fluvgeo,
`R/study_reach_merge.R` owns these guards and
`tests/testthat/test_study_reach_corridor.R` covers event reassignment, retained
history, linked-network rejection and geometry/evidence disagreement.

Reach buffers inherit the Stream's width, units, method and processing frame and
clip to the Stream extent. Adjacent extents may overlap. Split currently requires
a connected, unbranched supported line. Pre-assembly cuts and Stream splitting
are approved design directions, not implemented actions.

## Source identity is not editable-piece identity

Before piece editing, selection IDs correspond to whole source COMIDs. After the
first split, `selection_id` refers to local piece UUIDs; `source_id` still records
the original COMID and can repeat. Never deduplicate pieces by COMID. Source
intervals are tied to the exact retained line and are not FG stations.

The backend's `dev/schemas/reach-pieces.md` owns the exact contract. Piece-enabled
contexts require fluvgeo 2026.09.17.9032 or newer for these edits. Earlier context
and evidence files are not rewritten when opening or splitting. Renaming changes
current context names, not historical labels in source evidence.

## Tests and ownership

Start with `test-reach-selection.R`, `test-reach-split.R` and
`test-feature-names.R` under `tests/testthat`. These cover UI/adapter behavior with
temporary studies. Backend geometry belongs in fluvgeo tests, not duplicated in
the Shiny layer; start at `fluvgeo/tests/testthat/test_study_reach_split.R` for
split behavior. Read-only local preview scripts supplement synthetic tests but
do not publish changes to analyst studies. No absence of graph edges or successful
preview establishes scientific network acceptance.
